sourceRefs.title: ITG, Inc. preliminary prospectus
sourceRefs.evidenceSummary: The prospectus identifies Oaktree-controlled vehicles as pre-IPO owners but states that ITG, Inc. itself offered the base 19,512,196 shares to repay company borrowings and support growth.
